propositions: Core modules must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes must cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission and ingestion boundaries via port calls.

All package-root reconciler modules must have zero imports of adapters.jira, acli_subprocess, or lazy-key literals of rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira, with single recorded exemption of inbound_fields.py.
Vendor-specific modules (acli_subprocess, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, absence probe) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims.
The outbound differ must canonicalize fetched snapshots via InboundMapper and diff local-vs-local, with vendor payloads built only via injected OutboundMapper at emission.
Backend selection and transport construction must route through the pinned backend interface via config.reconciler.backend registry instead of provider literals or by-path loads.
